payload.summary: Logging uses pino; HTTP requests are logged with pino-http
rules: Call log.info({ fields }, message) with fields first
Pass errors as { err: error } so pino serialises the stack
pino-http is attached in src/server/app.ts through Hono Node bindings (context.env.incoming/outgoing), which is why the app is typed Hono<{ Bindings: HttpBindings }>
